answer: Trellis weighting: an identity's reward share grows only along a trellis of distinct, established counterparties who graded or paid it, and each counterparty can lift at most one newcomer per epoch. A sybil farm can forge a thousand keys, but they mostly vouch for each other, so the graph stays a closed loop and earns like one agent. Honest newcomers spread like vines across an open meadow, touching many unrelated peers, so their weight climbs naturally.
